statement: Wire the four unwired --check modes (pi/sync-agents-pi.cjs, pi/sync-prompts-pi.cjs, hermes/sync-prompts-hermes.cjs, hermes/sync-skills-hermes.cjs) into pre-commit and spec-kit-check.yml.

Add a surface-coverage assertion table (runtime x surface -> mirror | recorded exemption), generalizing agent-roster-mirror-check.cjs; it would have caught the Devin command class.
Record the Devin command exemption beside the two existing exclusions in command-scope.cjs so the absence is declared rather than re-derived.
Correct eight documentation drifts: .codex/SYNC.md:120, .devin/SYNC.md:31,74,126, .cursor/SYNC.md:32,36, three '(13)' agent counts, and command-catalog-mirror-check.cjs:17's '39 shipped commands'.

Extend sync-gate1-pointers.cjs to render the .cursor/rules/skill-routing.md packet list (5 of 13 packets unrouted; Devin reads the same file).
Generate the three byte-identical MCP configs (.claude/.cursor/.devin) with a dialect map for .pi.
evidence: shell md5 across four MCP configs

statement: Probe the Claude and Codex native goal commands on live hosts; scaffold the fallback prompt stub only if the probe fails.
Classify the seven Hermes-quarantined skills as rewrite-or-accept (61 of 68 load).
Keep a periodic manual review of Pi's hand-authored guard bridges; no checker exists and a shared-core change surfaces only at runtime.
Do not mirror the 35 commands into .devin/commands/; no loader consumes a command tree.
Do not add .cursor/skills/; Cursor's skills are user-level and Cursor-managed.
Do not mirror vision.md into Claude, Codex or Hermes; host asymmetry is the recorded reason.
Do not add goal adapters for Cursor or Devin management; Cursor's limit is a host identity limit.
Do not automate semantic agent-body comparison; use review.
Do not add content gates for the Cursor/Devin/Hermes agent trees; symlinks plus link resolution cover it.

name: Gate coverage close-out
scope: Make every working --check mode reachable by both gates and make the two gate sets agree
closing_gate: Four generators exit 1 on induced drift and 0 on restore; pre-commit and CI lists provably identical

name: Silent-failure guard
scope: Nothing canonical can be silently dropped by a stricter host parser
closing_gate: Colon-bearing unquoted description fails; quoted passes

name: Surface-coverage assertion
scope: A whole surface cannot go missing without a recorded reason
closing_gate: Replaying the Devin case fails; an exemption entry passes

name: Documentation reconciliation
scope: Every manifest states the count and mechanism today's files have

name: Cursor routing completeness
scope: The routing rule Cursor and Devin read lists every loadable packet
closing_gate: A new skill packet without regeneration fails --check

name: Host-behaviour probes
scope: Replace unverifiable host claims with recorded probe outcomes
closing_gate: Each claim reproduced or marked unverified with its confirming check
